name: Maasai Mara
tagline: Big cats, river crossings and Maasai culture
summary: The Maasai Mara is Kenya's most famous reserve, the northern end of the Great Migration. Watch big cats on the open savannah, wildebeest crossing the Mara River, and visit Maasai communities whose land surrounds the park.
seasonNote: The migration is here July to October. Long rains in April and May.
arrival: Fly 45 minutes from Nairobi's Wilson Airport, or drive 5-6 hours.
cashTip: Park fees are paid by card or M-Pesa; carry shillings or small US dollars for tips and village visits.
foodTip: Camp dining, nyama choma and ugali.
